## Redemption Deals

| Spend | Redeem Price | Link |
|-------|-------------|------|
| HKD100+ | HKD99 items | [99 Redemption](https://www.toysrus.com.hk/zh-hk/promotions/2026-christmas/christmas-redemption/99-redemption/) |
| HKD100+ | HKD149 items | [149 Redemption](https://www.toysrus.com.hk/zh-hk/promotions/2026-christmas/christmas-redemption/2026-149-redemption/) |

## Popular Christmas Gift Picks

- **Building Sets** - LEGO, BRIO wooden train sets
- **Interactive Toys** - Talking toys, music & dance robots
- **Puzzle & Learning** - Educational games for kids 3+

2. Check the clearance section for extra savings
3. Combine redemption deals with Double 11 promo code 1111 for stacked discounts
